rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the weekend.

example.english: I want to stay home and rest at the weekend.
example.traditional: 週末我想留喺屋企休息。
example.jyutping: zau1 mut6 ngo5 soeng2 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei5 jau1 sik1

rows.note: A speaker picks this when specifying the Saturday-and-Sunday days that make up the weekend.

example.english: We go hiking in Sai Kung at the weekend, on Saturday and Sunday.
example.traditional: 星期六日我哋去西貢行山。
example.jyutping: sing1 kei4 luk6 jat6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sai1 gung3 haang4 saan1

rows.note: A speaker picks this colloquial expression when referring to the end-of-the-week break.

example.english: We only have time to eat together at the weekend.
example.traditional: 禮拜尾我哋先得閒食飯。
example.jyutping: lai5 baai3 mei5 ngo5 dei6 sin1 dak1 haan4 sik6 faan6
